Min Income (single source / base)ICON+ $8,000 · then $2,500 / $2,000 / $1,600 / $1,400 by tier

Self-Employed — Disqualifiers>3 NSF in a month · >5 NSF in 3 months · negative or zero month-end balance · any month’s deposits under 50% of the 3-month average

Min Housing Expense$600/mo — per applicant if separate residences
GarnishmentsPaystub garnishments are treated as debt

changes.quote: Minimum housing expense of $600 per month (per applicant if separate residences). Paystub garnishments will be treated as debt.
changes.note: The record had DTI and PTI ceilings but none of the inputs CPS uses to reach them. A $600 housing floor, $100/mo per open auto, and revolving debt at 3% of balance all get budgeted whether or not the customer actually pays that — which changes whether a deal fits before it is ever submitted. Also adds the self-employed bank-statement disqualifiers and the handwritten-paystub rule.

changes.quote: Full Contract with all signatures/dates/accurate info., Odometer Statement, Buyers Order, Signed Title Application, Bookout for the month contracted, Signed Credit Application, Proof of vehicle ownership (Copy of the title or auction receipt), and Back-end products.
changes.note: The record listed POR, ITIN, phone and references but never the dealer stip list itself — the checklist for what actually has to be in the funding package. Also adds the automatic stip waivers, the Quick Stips shortcut for the three upper tiers, and the FTB live-with-family exclusion, which is a flat decline.

ambiguities.note: This sheet is the NON-FRANCHISED program and the record says so in docTitle. Southwest Kia Dallas is a franchise store. Every number here — advance, tiers, fees, max amount financed — may not be what the store is actually on. Worth asking the CPS rep for the franchised Exhibit A and putting it in Drive. Not changing anything on that basis.
Record says "N/A". This sheet states no chargeback policy either way, so it is unverified rather than confirmed.
